posts.text:
The biggest robot buyer in the Middle East isn't logistics or oil and gas. It's hospitals.

Of the 66 verified deployments in our database, 17 are in healthcare: surgical robots in Riyadh, Kuwait's public hospitals, AKDITAL's network in Morocco, and now Egypt's planned da Vinci pilots.

Construction and logistics follow with 10 each. Mobility (robotaxis and autonomous shuttles) has 7.

What this means: the region's buyers are already used to paying for capital-heavy robots with long procurement cycles. That's useful context for anyone selling here.

The sector filter is in the database. Link in the comments.

#Robotics #Healthcare #MENA #MedTech

posts.text:
We counted every deployment in our database that has a primary source and a date (66 so far).

By sector: healthcare 17, construction 10, logistics 10, mobility 7, retail 5, hospitality 4, energy 4.

By country: UAE 26, Saudi Arabia 17, Egypt 6, Qatar 5, Oman 4, Morocco 2, Jordan 2, and one each in Bahrain, Algeria, Kuwait and Tunisia.

Two caveats: English and Arabic sources are easier for us to find than French ones, so the Maghreb is probably under-counted. And a deployment can be one surgical robot or a fleet of 70 robotaxis.

What surprises you here? What are we missing in Morocco, Tunisia and Algeria?

(The data is at roboticsmena.com/database if you want to check or correct a record.)

posts.title: ADNOC says it has 70 robotics use cases. We mapped the ones that are actually on the record
posts.text:
We (Robotics MENA, roboticsmena.com, this is our own site) just published a report on the robots ADNOC is using or buying. At ADIPEC an ADNOC Offshore executive put the number at 70 use cases deployed or in development, but there's no public list, so we went through releases and trade press to see what is actually confirmed.

What we could confirm:

Gecko Robotics' Raptor, a wall-climbing crawler that scans steel with ultrasound, is being deployed across ADNOC facilities.
Taurob's explosion-proof inspection robot has been in live operation at the Taweelah gas compression plant since May 2026.
ADNOC Drilling's AD-300 island rig, with automated pipe handling, was delivered in June 2026.
ADNOC L&S has two 60-metre remotely operated landing craft on order with SeaOwl. Delivery dates differ between sources (late 2026 or 2027).
ADNOC Onshore agreed in November to trial Unitree robots, including humanoids.

Most of the headline numbers are company claims, projections or contract ceilings rather than measured results, and we tried to label each one. Curious whether anyone here works with inspection robots on Gulf sites: do the speed claims hold up in practice?

Report (free): https://roboticsmena.com/spotlight?s=gecko-adnoc-raptor
Source for the 70 figure: Khaleej Times, https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/adnoc-expansion-ai-robotics-energy-operations
